it.polimi.ingsw.persistence.GameSnapshot
public record GameSnapshot(int gameId, int numberOfPlayers, String gameState, String currentAge, String playerInTurnNick, List<String> currentRoundOrderNicks, List<PlayerSnapshot> players, BoardSnapshot board, TurnOrderSnapshot turnOrder, List<Integer> deckEraI, List<Integer> deckEraII, List<Integer> deckEraIII, List<Integer> finalEventIds, List<Integer> buildingsInGameIds, int topPicks, int bottomPicks, List<String> botNicknames) extends Record
JSON-serializable snapshot of the entire game (Game). Aggregates all sub-snapshots; contains no references to model objects.
